gloss: to teach and guide; to mentor

definitions.gloss: to teach and guide; to mentor; to lead and instruct
definitions.explanation: To both teach knowledge and guide someone in the right direction. Implies a deeper, more personal form of education than simply teaching facts. Often used for mentoring, parenting, and spiritual guidance.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちを{教|おし}え{導|みちび}く。
{恩師|おんし}に{教|おし}え{導|みちび}かれて{今|いま}の{自分|じぶん}がある。
examples.english: I am who I am today because my mentor taught and guided me.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{世代|せだい}を{正|ただ}しい{方向|ほうこう}に{教|おし}え{導|みちび}くのは{大人|おとな}の{責任|せきにん}だ。
examples.english: It is the responsibility of adults to teach and guide the younger generation in the right direction.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: {教|おし}える (to teach) + {導|みちび}く (to lead/guide). The combination emphasizes both the instructional and directional aspects of guidance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子供|こども}を{教|おし}え{導|みちび}く (to teach and guide children)
- {正|ただ}しく{教|おし}え{導|みちび}く (to guide correctly)
- {教|おし}え{導|みちび}く{立場|たちば} (a position of mentoring)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指導|しどう}する: to instruct, to coach — more formal and institutional
- {導|みちび}く: to guide, to lead — emphasis on direction rather than teaching
- {諭|さと}す: to admonish gently, to counsel — emphasis on moral persuasion
